_notice: FICTITIOUS. Speaker program and transparency-reporting rules for a product that does not exist, at a company that does not exist. The rates, caps, state entries and reporting thresholds are the pack's own illustrative figures, not any company's policy, any state's law or the federal figures.
usage: Arden Quay's rules for promotional speaker programs and for reporting the payments they generate to the federal Open Payments program. population/speaker-programs.json and population/open-payments.json are generated against them, and the validator recomputes every program's quality flags and the full set of Open Payments records from the programs, the speaker roster (population/speakers.json) and the Form FDA 2253 filings of the speaker deck. Speaker programs are promotional: the speaker presents the approved deck, PROMO-SPEAKER-DECK in promotional/promo-materials.json, in the version current on the program date.

honoraria._comment: US dollars per completed program, by speaker tier and format.

state_restrictions._comment: Arden Quay policy for programs held in these states, loosely modeled on state rules and the pack's own simplification. They are not statements of any state's law.

rules.rule: The speaker is on the speaker roster with a contract covering the program date (speaker_not_contracted) and was trained on the deck version presented before the program date (untrained_speaker).

The speaker presents the deck version current on the program date: the latest version filed on Form FDA 2253 whose first use is on or before that date (superseded_deck). Presenting a version not yet filed is never allowed.

The honorarium for a completed program is the rate for the speaker's tier and the program's format (honorarium_off_rate). A cancelled program pays nothing. A program whose honorarium takes the speaker's calendar-year total over annual_honoraria_cap is flagged over_annual_cap.

The meal cost per person is the meal total divided by everyone who ate: signed-in prescribers, office staff, any guests and the speaker, but not Arden Quay employees. It may not exceed meal_cap_per_person (meal_over_cap), or the state's cap or ban where the program is held (state_meal_restriction). Virtual programs serve no meal.
Only healthcare professionals with a business reason to attend may eat. A meal for a guest who is not a healthcare professional, such as a spouse, is flagged guest_meal.
A completed program has at least minimum_attendees signed-in prescribers, not counting the speaker (low_attendance).
A prescriber may attend a program on the same deck at most once in repeat_window_days; each later attendance is flagged repeat_attendee with the prescriber's id.
The venue is one of allowed_venue_types; a venue chosen for entertainment, such as a winery or a sports venue, is flagged entertainment_venue.

Every payment or transfer of value to a covered recipient is reported to Open Payments for the program year in which it was made: for speaker programs, the honorarium (Compensation for services other than consulting, including serving as faculty or as a speaker at a venue other than a continuing education program), the speaker's travel (Travel and Lodging) and each covered recipient's meal (Food and Beverage).

Covered recipients here are the prescribers in population/hcps.json: physicians (MD, DO), nurse practitioners and physician assistants. Office staff, nurses and medical assistants are not covered recipients; their meals count toward the per-person cost but are not reported.

A meal is reported at the per-person cost of SPK-04, rounded to the cent, only for a covered recipient who signed in and ate. A payment below the program year's single threshold is reported only if the recipient's total payments for that year reach the aggregate threshold.

A record missing from the report is flagged payment_not_reported on its program, with the recipient and the nature of payment. A reported record that should not exist, or that carries the wrong amount, is flagged on the record itself.

thresholds._comment: Illustrative pack figures. The federal program publishes its own single and aggregate thresholds each year.

natures_of_payment.speaker_compensation: Compensation for services other than consulting, including serving as faculty or as a speaker at a venue other than a continuing education program
